title: Ultra-sensitive low-frequency dual-mode humidity sensor using a methyl red-PVA-graphene oxide composite
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1888-1899
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07420G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mushahid Hussain, Nadir Ali Khan, Wei-Chun Lin, Muhammad Yaseen, Fakhra Aziz, Muhammad Ali, Naseem Abbas
In this study, a novel ternary composite (MPG), composed of methyl red (MR), polyvinyl alcohol (PVA), and graphene oxide (GO), is synthesized and employed for the fabrication of a humidity sensor.
